specs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept, production Unity game sprite animation atlas. Using ONLY the LEFTMOST option in the reference sheet, turn that approved design into SIX distinct consecutive animation sprites. Preserve its design and palette closely. Output exactly 1536x1024 pixels in a precise 3 columns x 2 rows grid, six 512x512 equal invisible cells in reading order. TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha background everywhere around sprites, NOT black or checkerboard painted in. No labels, text, separator lines, borders, UI, characters or background. In EVERY cell the effect's center anchor is at the exact center of that 512x512 cell; the full effect including sparks stays within a centered 352x352 safe region. Do not translate the effect across cells: Unity will handle travel. No rotation between frames, consistent direction and scale basis. Authentic crisp clustered PIXEL ART with clear block edges, not smooth vector gradients. Six-frame one-shot lifecycle: frame 1 small faint coherent energy forming (about 55% mature extent); frame 2 rising coherent shape (80%); frame 3 complete shape (100%); frame 4 peak complete shape (100%, slightly brighter core); frame 5 fading thinner coherent shape (85%, no explosion); frame 6 very faint small residual brush tips near center (45%). Animate the internal flow and contour, not six exact duplicates. Keep the center aligned, short tail, restrained sparks very close to silhouette, no expanding shockwave or distant debris. The result must be clean game-ready isolated VFX frame art. Select A1 ONLY: one slender vertical moon-crescent sword energy, bulging convex bright ivory leading edge on the RIGHT, muted jade/cyan body, short dark teal brush trail on left. Arc points top/bottom, opening left. The peak frame closely matches A1. Never replace with A2 straight thrust or A3 cross. No physical sword.
